title: Wisdom {DAY}
subtitle: Market context (OUTSIDE), the book's issues, capital and cash reserve, and the session path of the day's theme. Levels from tv_scan_cli.py name-levels, session path from intraday.

blocks.text: Two all-fields runs of the day: drift_pct is the move from the early run to the later one; session_path says whether the morning move built or faded. Absent on a day with one run.

source.sql: SELECT ind, n, change_a_med, drift_med, drift_up_pct, change_b_med FROM drift_by_ind WHERE n >= 5 ORDER BY drift_med DESC

blocks.title: Named names: early vs later session

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, change_a, drift_pct, change_b, relvol_b, session_path FROM drift
